name: Single-Arm Push-up
how_to:
Setup

- Choose a Stable Surface
  - Perform on a flat, non-slippery surface to ensure balance.
- Position Yourself
  - Assume a push-up position with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart for added stability.
- Place One Hand Behind Your Back
  - Position your supporting hand under your chest, slightly offset toward the midline of your body.
Execution

- Lower Your Body
  - Bend your elbow to lower your chest toward the floor, keeping your body aligned.
  - Engage your core to avoid torso rotation or sagging hips.
- Pause at the Bottom
  - Hold briefly at the lowest point to maximize muscle activation.
- Push Back Up
  - Press through your palm to return to the starting position.
- Repeat
  - Perform the desired number of reps on one side, then switch to the other arm.
